title: se-implementation-scratchpad-maple-grove-bank
content:
SE Implementation Scratchpad — Maple Grove Bank
Owner: Alex Chen
Context: Private deployment (VPC) + Dedicated capacity for customer-facing chat assistants. High security, SOC2 + regional data residency (US-East).

Key contacts:
- PM: Jordan White
- Customer SE contact: Lisa Moroz (Maple Grove IT)
- Account Exec: Samira Khan
- Infra contact: Heather Li (RWI infra)

Top-level goals for Phase 1
- Secure VPC peering and routing for customer to send inference requests to Redwood Private control plane (non-prod by 11/20, prod by 12/05).
- Dedicated pool with A100 80GB equivalent (initial sizing for 20 rps @ p50 latency < 200ms for chat gen).
- Canary rollout with auto-fallback to hosted model variant for capacity/backfill.
- Enable audit logging + KMS integration for model inputs/outputs retention policy (90 days).

Daily notes / timeline
2025-11-12 (Kickoff)
- Intro call with Lisa, confirmed regulatory boundary: no customer PII stored in hosted logs; Private deployment required for prod.
- Action: send network requirements (done).

2025-11-13
- Received customer network diagram. Customer uses Transit VPC and expects us to peer into mg-transit-prod (10.10.0.0/16).
- Need to confirm if Redwood control plane will call back into any customer endpoints (not for inference path).

2025-11-14
- Internal architecture sync with infra. Proposal: Private control plane running in RWI-managed AWS account with VPC peering to customer. Router rules: allow 10.10.0.0/16 -> 10.20.0.0/16 (RWI).
- TODO: finalize CIDR overlap checks with customer.

2025-11-18 (Load testing prep)
- Baseline: opt-13b-8bit (quant) gave ~85ms/token on A100 80GB in our test harness. For 20 rps chat we estimate 8 dedicated GPUs in initial pool (buffer for spikes).
- Action: run 2-hour soak test with synthetic traffic (similar token distribution to customer sample).

Checklist / action items (ordered)
- [x] Prepare network requirements doc and send to customer (11/12)
- [ ] Confirm CIDR overlap and peering window from customer (owner: Lisa) — follow up 11/20
- [ ] Finalize instance/GPU sizing and reserved pool commit (owner: Alex) — target 11/19
- [ ] Provision private control plane skeleton in staging account (owner: Heather) — ETA 11/19
- [ ] Terraform for VPC peering + route propagation (owner: infra team) — PR queued (#332)
- [ ] End-to-end test: upload model, route traffic, verify audit logs (owner: Jordan) — target 11/21
- [ ] Canary policy config: 5% traffic -> new model, auto-fallback to hosted (owner: Alex/Jordan)
- [ ] KMS integration with customer key (owner: security) — start 11/20

Open questions / risks
- Customer insists on customer-managed HSM for encryption at rest. We need to confirm compatibility with our Private control plane (we support BYOK via AWS KMS external keys but need HSM contract detail).
- Model licensing: customer wants an audited open-model. Confirm preferred family (we suggested vicuna-13b-8bit / opt-13b quant).
- Network ACLs require outbound-only from their transit to us? Clarify if they require NAT gateway or direct routing.

Config snippets / helpful commands (for testing)
- Simple Redwood API test (staging private control plane):
  curl -X POST https://private-controlplane.staging.redwood.local/v1/predict \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $RWI_STAGING_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"vicuna-13b-8bit","input":"Hello, can you summarize last quarter performance?","max_tokens":200}'

- Example rollout policy (CLI pseudo):
  rwi rollout create --name mgb-canary --model vicuna-13b-8bit --canary-percent 5 --fallback hosted:v1 --health-checks 3

- Recommended instance sizing (initial):
  - GPU: A100 80GB or equivalent (8 GPUs in pool)
  - CPU nodes: r5b.8xlarge for control-plane tasks
  - Storage: encrypted EBS gp3 1TB per node (audit logs + model cache)

Network requirements (sent to customer)
- Peering: request peering between mg-transit-prod (10.10.0.0/16) and rwi-mg-prod (10.20.0.0/16)
- Ports (egress from customer to RWI): 443 (HTTPS) outbound to control plane endpoints; 5228 if we enable internal agent comms (TBD)
- DNS: customer will allow rwi-managed private hosted zone; alternative: we will use static IPs for endpoints and request CIDR allowlist

Notes from infra PR (#332)
- Terraform variables to set: rwi_vpc_cidr = "10.20.0.0/16", peer_vpc_cidr = "10.10.0.0/16"
- Route table association step: ensure propagate to mgb-transit-rtb for cross-account transit gateways (customer uses TGW)

Testing plan (short)
1) Staging: deploy private control plane in rwi-staging account, peer with mgb-staging transit, sanity test with single GPU pool.
2) Soak: run 2hr 20rps synthetic chat traffic, check latency percentiles and OOMs.
3) Canary: route 5% of customer staging traffic to staging model, validate logs and quality.
4) Prod rollout: after sign-off, schedule 1am maintenance window and cutover to prod private control plane.

Meeting notes snippets
- Lisa (11/12): customer wants A/C: no PII in hosted logs; they will provide list of sensitive fields to redact at the gateway. Also asked for audit retention >= 90 days.
- Jordan (11/14): we'll add extra KV cache retention for session affinity (helps p50 latency for repeated prompts).

Quick reminders (personal)
- Ping Lisa for peering window + contact for network ops (11/20 morning).
- Confirm budget approval for reserved GPUs (Account/Biz) — Samira to loop in finance.
- Attach customer sample prompts (they shared CSV) to Confluence page for evals.

Last edits / next steps
- 11/19: finalize sizing and open infra PR to provision staging control plane (Heather).
- 11/20: follow up on CIDR and KMS requirements.
- Blockers: Customer-owned HSM contract details; if longer lead time, propose short-term using RWI-managed KMS + strict audit logs until HSM is provisioned.

-- End scratchpad --
